data.name: MM Grand Hotel Puebla, Tapestry Collection by Hilton
data.address: Blvd. Atlixco 4303, La Providencia, 72180 Heroica Puebla de Zaragoza, Pue., Mexico
data.description:
This relaxed all-suite hotel is 2 km from Arts Garden, and 9 km from both the 17th-century Biblioteca Palafoxiana and Amparo Museum.
Formal suites offer complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV and sitting areas, plus minibars, safes and air-conditioning. Some are split-level and/or have free-standing tubs.
Amenities include a restaurant, a bar and event space. Breakfast and parking are available.
